out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Described 'two of me': one outside the body observing self and surroundings with '360 degrees around,' and one inside the body; later said the 'spirit went right back in my body' when others touched him.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: He reported being 'very peaceful, very calm,' with 'no pain' and 'no concern,' and later being 'bathed in the white light' while functioning during combat and evacuation.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: He 'moved forward in the dark tunnel/dark corridor' toward the light, then later 'turned around and walked away' back through the corridor.

arrival.other_being_detail: A second 'being' who was 'in charge'/'in authority' told him he could not go on and must return; also stated he had a 'higher purpose' and would live a 'relatively long and productive life.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He 'turned around and walked away' through the dark corridor; later during combat he described an external spirit perspective that 'went right back in my body' when others touched him.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Told he had a 'higher purpose to fulfill' and later framed this as being guided to 'talk to people,' pursue a helping career, and tell his story (book/speaking).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Shrapnel from an air strike 'crushed my face and tore out my right eye'; later was shot five times (arm/chest/neck).

person_demographics.occupation: Soldier (later became a counselor/social worker; author/speaker).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: After return, he reported seeing a dying comrade's 'spirit rise up' and communicating telepathically; also reported an ongoing sense of being 'bathed in the white light' during recovery and later life guidance.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/tunnel/light/encounter with grandfather and authority being; told to return; then later during ongoing combat/evacuation he described a dual-perspective OBE-like state and continued 'bathed in light.'
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: During the post-NDE battlefield period he described being both outside and inside his body at the same time ('two of me').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Post-return: perceived a dying comrade's spirit as a 'white cloud' rising from head/chest and communicated telepathically; extended 'bathed in white light' state during combat, evacuation, and recovery; described walking 'through hedgerows' unobstructed and 360-degree perception.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I had gone into this dark tunnel.” / “I passed into a bright, white light… full of this unconditional love and this great knowledge of the universe.” / “He told me… I had a higher purpose to fulfill… regardless of what happened that day, I would not die and… would live a relatively long and productive life.” / “It was as if there were two of me… [the outside part] could see 360 degrees around.” / “There aren’t words… to describe the experience that I had.”
